1. (Currently amended) An Internet system that supports a search service, the Internet system comprising: a search server implemented as a programmable processor executing stored instructions that is adapted to receive search criteria from a client device remote from the search server; and a historical data repository comprising computer hardware including storage media; wherein the search server receives the search criteria to search for older historical data that was in existence on the Internet at a previous time, wherein the search server obtains search results to satisfy the search criteria by searching the historical data stored in the historical data repository, and wherein the search server is configured to search for historical data that was previously available on the Internet at a specific point in time by searching within a website visit history database that stores information corresponding to websites visited by users.

2. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is date tagged so that the historical data is associated with a date representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the date tagging is performed by hardware circuitry that associates date metadata with the contents in an index database.

3. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 2 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the time tagging is performed by hardware circuitry that associates time metadata with the contents in the index database.

4. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the time tagging is performed by hardware circuitry that associates time metadata with the contents in an index database.

6. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data repository comprises: central processing circuitry; communication circuitry coupled to the central processing circuitry for communicating data in to and out from the historical data repository; and local storage coupled to the central processing circuitry that contains an index storage module for storing historical data according to indices and a time based sorting module for storing historical data according to date and time, wherein the index storage module stores website visit history within a predetermined time interval.

7. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein certain data is removed from the historical data before it is placed for long-term storage within the historical data repository, and wherein the removal of certain data is performed by filtering out websites that are registered in a blacklist prior to storage.

20. (Currently amended) A network browser in a computer for browsing websites, the network browser comprising: a search criteria window that prompts a user to enter search terms and timeline information; a first module that enables a search of the Internet to determine search results that existed within a time frame delineated by the timeline information, and wherein the search results correlate to the search terms, wherein the search is performed on a distributed system for resources or data which meet conditions defined by the search terms and the timeline information; and a second module that receives the search results from over the Internet, wherein the first module and second module are implemented as hardware circuitry or a programmable processor executing stored instructions.
